environment.description: Go microservice running on ECS Fargate in a VPC with standard NAT gateway egress. The task role has s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::app-config-store-prod/*. No VPC endpoint for S3 is configured; traffic routes through NAT to public S3 endpoint. No input validation middleware. CONFIG_BUCKET=app-config-store-prod.
